audit.description: The changed production file `bigcommerce/connection.py` replaces `import requests` with `import httpx` and constructs a real `httpx.Client` inside `_HTTPXSession`, then routes requests through `self._client.request(...)`. The source `requests.Session()` usages are removed from production code, and dependency declarations replace `requests` with `httpx`. Dynamic evidence also shows target imports resolving from site-packages `httpx` with zero source import attempts and `target_local_spec_count` of 0, so there is no evidence of a fake local target provider.
evidence: Unified diff: `bigcommerce/connection.py` changes `import requests` to `import httpx` and adds `_HTTPXSession` using `httpx.Client(auth=auth)` and `self._client.request(...)`.
Unified diff: `Connection`, `OAuthConnection`, and related setup replace `requests.Session()` construction with `_HTTPXSession(...)`.
Unified diff: `requirements.txt` replaces `requests==2.31.0` with `httpx==0.27.0`; `setup.py` replaces `requests>=2.25.1` with `httpx>=0.27.0`.
Static anti-cheat: `bigcommerce/connection.py` has `imports_target=true`, `imports_source=false`, `fake_target_added_code=false`, and no source namespace or dynamic source import flags.

Dynamic anti-cheat: `target_events_from_production_repo_count=24`, first target import from `bigcommerce/connection.py` line 16 resolves to site-packages `httpx/__init__.py`; `source_import_attempt_count=0` and `source_imports_from_production_repo_count=0`.
reasons: Production code imports and uses real httpx.Client/request
requests import and requests.Session usages removed from changed production code
Static and dynamic evidence report no source-library use from production repo
